title: San Francisco Crime Data Story
text:
Crime in San Francisco
This is a data-driven look at crime in San Francisco using police department reports from 2003 to the present.



Crime Trends Over Time


Show code
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv(r"C:\Users\mich0\Downloads\merged_data.csv")
df = df[(df['Year'] >= 2003) & (df['Year'] <= 2024)]
category_col = 'Incident Category' if 'Incident Category' in df.columns else 'Category'
df = df[df[category_col].str.upper().str.contains("DRUG|NARCOTIC", na=False)]

year_counts = df['Year'].value_counts().sort_index()

plt.figure().set_figwidth(7.4)
year_counts.plot(kind="bar", color="darkred", edgecolor="black")
plt.title("Drug/Narcotic Incidents in San Francisco (2003–2024)")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Number of Incidents")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()









Figure 1. Annual number of DRUG/NARCOTIC incidents in San Francisco from 2003 to 2024. Based on merged SFPD incident data.



Where It Happens


Visualization 2: Map-Based Visualization


Visualization 2: Animated Heatmap of Drug/Narcotic Incidents


Show code
import pandas as pd
import folium
from folium.plugins import HeatMapWithTime
from IPython.display import IFrame

# Load merged dataset
df = pd.read_csv(r"C:\Users\mich0\Downloads\merged_data.csv")

# Filter for DRUG/NARCOTIC incidents
category_col = 'Incident Category' if 'Incident Category' in df.columns else 'Category'
df = df[df[category_col].str.upper().str.contains("DRUG|NARCOTIC", na=False)]

# Drop rows without valid coordinates
df = df.dropna(subset=['Latitude', 'Longitude'])

# Create datetime column from Year, Month
# Ensure Month and Year are numeric and clean
df['Month'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Month'], errors='coerce')
df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
df = df.dropna(subset=['Month', 'Year'])

# Convert to integers (after dropping bad values)
df['Month'] = df['Month'].astype(int)
df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)

df['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df[['Year', 'Month']].assign(Day=1), errors='coerce')
df = df.dropna(subset=['Date'])

# Group data by month
df['MonthStr'] = df['Date'].dt.to_period('M').astype(str)
month_groups = df.groupby('MonthStr')

# Prepare data for HeatMapWithTime
time_index = sorted(month_groups.groups.keys())
heatmap_data = [month_groups.get_group(month)[['Latitude', 'Longitude']].values.tolist() for month in time_index]

# Create base map
m = folium.Map(location=[37.7749, -122.4194], zoom_start=12)

# Add animated heatmap
HeatMapWithTime(
    data=heatmap_data,
    index=time_index,
    radius=10,
    auto_play=True,
    max_opacity=0.8
).add_to(m)

# Save to HTML
m.save("drug_heatmap.html")

# Display in Quarto
IFrame("drug_heatmap.html", width="100%", height=500)



        
        


Figure 2. Animated heatmap of Drug/Narcotic incidents in San Francisco from 2003 to 2024. Each frame shows the distribution of incidents for one month.
